# Birko.Data.CosmosDB.Views

<!-- spec-links: generated by Birko.Framework/spec-links.cs from docs/specs/.map.yml. Do not edit: change the map and run `dotnet run spec-links.cs`. -->
**Specs**: [views-and-aggregation](../Birko.Framework/docs/specs/views-and-aggregation.md)

## Overview
Azure Cosmos DB (NoSQL API) implementation of the Birko.Data.Views interfaces, providing read-only view queries over Cosmos DB containers.

## Project Location
`Birko.Data.CosmosDB.Views/`

## Purpose
- Read-only view queries over Cosmos DB containers via `IViewStore<TView>`
- View lifecycle management via `IViewManager`
- Cosmos SQL projection (`SELECT c["Source"] AS "ViewProp"`) for non-aggregate views (TASK-151: LINQ ignored renames)
- Cosmos SQL with GROUP BY for aggregate views

## Components

### CosmosViewStore\<TView\>
- Implements `IViewStore<TView>` for querying views
- Non-aggregate views: a Cosmos SQL projection with WHERE/ORDER BY/OFFSET LIMIT on the source fields the view properties select; `CountAsync` is `SELECT VALUE COUNT(1)`
- Grouping views (aggregates or GroupBy): `QueryFirstAsync` and `CountAsync` take the GROUP BY path too; the count is the number of groups the view's own query returns
- A filter on an aggregate view property is refused (it would need HAVING); `Persistent` mode is refused (no stored views)
- Aggregate views: Cosmos SQL with GROUP BY via `QueryDefinition` and `GetItemQueryIterator<TView>`
- Field names use property names as-is (matching SDK default serialization); a nested source (`r.Sub.X`, TASK-843) is selected as `c["Sub"]["X"]` (`CosmosAggregationHelper.PathRef`), and a filter or sort on its view property reads the same path
- **Every identifier is quoted (TASK-844).** Aliases are quoted strings, `c["Sub"] AS "Inner"` (`CosmosAggregationHelper.Alias`, the one producer, also for group-by and aggregate aliases); WHERE and ORDER BY paths are bracket-quoted, `c["Sub"]["Value"]` (`PathRef`). Measured on the emulator (vnext-preview, 2026-11-07): a bare `AS Inner` / `AS Value` and a dotted `c.Value` / `c.Sub.Value` are 400 SC1001 syntax errors; `AS "Value"` works (`[Value]` and backticks do not). So any property name works
- **ORDER BY an aggregate view property (`Total`) is refused with `NotSupportedException`, by name, before any request (TASK-848).** Cosmos DB cannot run it in any form, also as a second key after a group key (bare alias SC2001, quoted alias or the aggregate expression 2206, measured on the emulator 2026-11-07); it used to be sent and fail with a 400. Not sorted in memory: a grouped read pages on the server (`OFFSET … LIMIT`, measured), so a correct page would mean reading every group first. Ordering by a group key works, paged too
- Aggregate SQL built via shared `CosmosAggregationHelper` from `Birko.Data.CosmosDB`
- **SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX skip nulls (TASK-885).** Each argument is `IS_NULL(x) ? undefined : x`. Before, a group holding a null answered no SUM and no AVG, and a null MIN (measured on the emulator, 2026-11-10). Over no non-null value, SUM is 0, as C#'s `Sum` over `int?` is; AVG, MIN and MAX are absent, so the property is null
- **Two filter translators, kept on measurement (TASK-885).** View filters go through `CosmosFilterTranslator`; the store's reads and aggregates go through the SDK's LINQ provider. 34 filter shapes were compared against C# on the emulator (2026-11-10):
  - **Both wrong:** `!(Score > 20)` misses the null rows.
  - **Store only wrong:** `Score.HasValue` matches every row; `string.Compare(x, "c2") > 0` misses a row.
  - **View refuses 11 shapes by name:** `HasValue`, StartsWith, a bool member and its negation, `+`, `%`, ToLower, IsNullOrEmpty, column vs column, Equals, Compare. The store answers 8 of them right, 2 wrong (`HasValue`, Compare), and refuses IsNullOrEmpty.

  Moving the view onto the store's translator would turn two of those refusals into wrong answers. So the view keeps its own translator until the LINQ provider's wrong shapes are fixed or refused (filed separately)
- Joins are refused in the constructor (`NotSupportedException`); Cosmos DB has no cross-document join

### CosmosViewManager
- Implements `IViewManager` for persistent view lifecycle
- `EnsureAsync`: refuses a Persistent definition or a join; otherwise nothing to create (views are computed on the fly)
- `DropAsync`: no-op — no container is ever a view, and deleting one deleted data (TASK-151)
- `ExistsAsync`: always false, for the same reason
- `RefreshAsync`: No-op (views are computed on-the-fly)

### CosmosFilterTranslator
- Internal helper that translates `Expression<Func<T, bool>>` filters into Cosmos SQL WHERE clauses
- Supports binary comparisons (==, !=, <, >, <=, >=), logical AND/OR, NOT, and string Contains (a substring test)
- Collection `Contains` (TASK-839) renders `ARRAY_CONTAINS`, an exact comparison (no collation), in two shapes:
  - `ids.Contains(v.Key)` (list, array, any `IEnumerable<T>`; span form normalised by `SpanContains.Rewrite`, rule 47) → `ARRAY_CONTAINS(@p, c.Key)`, the whole list bound as **one** array parameter. Guid, int, string, enum (as its number) values
  - `v.Tags.Contains(x)` on a view array property → `ARRAY_CONTAINS(c.Tags, @p)`
  - An empty list renders `false` (matches nothing; `!` of it matches everything). `!` and `||` compose
  - Paths go through `MapViewPropertyToSource`; an aggregate view property is refused by name
  - Refused by name, before any request: a comparer overload, a computed operand (`ids.Contains(v.N + 1)`), a collection of collections, both sides reading the view
- **The list still counts toward the 524,288-character limit.** Measured on the emulator (vnext-preview, 2026-11-07): the server counts the serialized parameter values with the query text (13,795 Guids pass, 25,000 fail with SC3020; 65,530 seven-digit ints pass). So `CosmosViewStore` plans every non-grouped read and count through TASK-834's `CosmosInListChunking.Plan` (one producer, Birko.Data.CosmosDB): a list of more than `InListChunkSize` (1000) distinct values in a plain AND conjunct is run once per chunk, rows concatenated and counts summed. Its length is measured as query text + each parameter as JSON
- Past `MaxQueryTextLength` the planner refuses with `NotSupportedException`, before any request, what it cannot split: NOT, OR, a sort / limit / offset, and `QueryFirstAsync`. String lists are split like any other (TASK-841: Cosmos DB compares strings exactly, measured for case, trailing space and Unicode composition; the SQL planner still refuses them). A grouped view is never split (a group can span chunks) and is refused past the limit. Below the limit all of these run as one query
- `InListChunkSize` and `MaxQueryTextLength` are `protected virtual` so a test (or a consumer) can lower them

## Dependencies
- Birko.Data.Views (IViewStore, IViewManager, ViewDefinition)
- Birko.Data.Stores (OrderBy, OrderByHelper, AggregateFunction)
- Birko.Data.CosmosDB (CosmosAggregationHelper)
- Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos (Container, Database, QueryDefinition)

## Important Notes
- Cosmos DB does not support cross-container joins; join clauses in ViewDefinition are refused
- Cosmos DB does not support native server-side views; all queries are computed on-the-fly
- Every query is raw, parameterised Cosmos SQL
- A true materialized view would require change-feed-based pipelines (Azure Functions), which is beyond scope
